text_block_list.text:
The day of the Wakagoma Stakes had finally 
arrived.

Right before the race, Tokai Teio 
accidentally walked into Nice Nature's 
waiting room and boldly made a victory 
declaration with full confidence.

Ignored completely by Tokai Teio, Nice 
Nature enthusiastically headed to the 
race, determined to show her what she was 
made of.
